title: Actual objc2-app-kit request: bounded parallel output verification
decision: Continue to full Harness A/B; no full-build or kache speed claim.

upstream_workload.origin: Actual full Harness compiler request, cloned registry package with unchanged prebuilt dependencies

replay.method: Actual Harness objc2-app-kit 0.3.2 request; same binary, fixed prebuilt inputs and paths, cloned package, separately primed keys, fifteen alternating warm pairs, preserved-mtime exported-constant edit, direct/fresh output and compiler-stream checks, linked edited consumer, revert hits, preserved-mtime large-blob corruption and repair. Trace/profile enabled throughout. Not full Cargo timing or kache comparison.

derived_phase_analysis.method: Parse preserved stderr with compiler_phase_profiles.EVENT; request label derived from frozen replay request and runner. No per-request command JSON was captured. Original report has an empty compiler_phase_profiles array because collect() expected command JSON; retained unchanged.

verification.scope: Actual request diagnostic, contended sampled host; not full Cargo, independent quiet confirmation or kache comparison. Earlier physical outputs were replaced; their captured manifests and saved streams are checked, with final outputs and repaired blob rehashed.

host_activity.limits: Snapshots cover only the monitor interval. Known build-tool names and ancestry are heuristic; zero observations do not prove an idle machine. ps CPU values are platform-specific snapshots, not integrated CPU time. No command arguments, environments, executable paths or unrelated process IDs are retained. No samples are removed and no process is stopped.

limitations: Trace/profile enabled throughout the replay. One actual request, not Cargo scheduling or a kache comparison.
Recognized external builds appeared in 96 of 158 host observations. No samples excluded; short calls may have no internal host observation.

The raw report phase array is empty because the collector expected per-request JSON. The separate derived phase analysis parses saved stderr, identifies the request from the frozen runner, and preserves the original report unchanged.

Compiler stdout/stderr are byte-equal after removing Nano trace lines. Every recorded artifact byte/mode map matches the direct reference. Final physical artifacts and repaired CAS blob were independently rehashed; earlier physical outputs were replaced by subsequent calls.
Only three edited consumers were linked and executed; source edit and corruption checks are correctness tests, not repeated edit/cold timing claims.
